services.name: Knob-and-tube replacement
services.blurb: Old knob-and-tube circuits retired and rewired through attic and walls, with small cuts patched.

services.name: Room-by-room rewiring
services.blurb: Plaster houses rewired one room at a time so you can keep living in the rest.

services.name: Panel replacement
services.blurb: Fuse boxes and small panels replaced with a labeled panel sized for a modern kitchen.

services.name: Two-prong outlet updates
services.blurb: Two-hole outlets in old living rooms grounded or GFCI-protected, with the reason explained.

services.name: Kitchen circuits
services.blurb: Dedicated circuits for dishwashers, microwaves and counters, so the toaster stops tripping the lights.

services.name: Push-button switch restoration
services.blurb: Reproduction push-button switches and brass plates wired safely into original bungalow boxes.

services.name: EV charger installation
services.blurb: A Level 2 charger in the detached garage, with the trench or overhead run planned with you.

services.name: Lighting and ceiling fans
services.blurb: Period fixtures rehung, fans added on braced boxes, and porch lights put on a switch.

services.name: Electrical inspections
services.blurb: Pre-purchase and insurance inspections of older homes, with photos of every finding.

reviews.text: Our 1924 Brookside bungalow still had knob-and-tube in the attic. Walt's crew rewired it over a week, a room at a time, and the plaster patches are hard to find.
reviews.name: Megan F.

reviews.text: We kept the look of our original push-button switches with reproductions. The front room finally has a grounded outlet and the brass plates still match the door hardware.
reviews.name: Jim L.

reviews.text: Every time the microwave ran, the kitchen lights went out. Two new circuits later we can run the toaster and the coffee pot at the same time.
reviews.name: Priya D.

reviews.text: Our insurer wanted an inspection on our 1930s Tudor before renewing. The report came with photos and plain notes on what mattered now and what could wait.
reviews.name: Tom B.

reviews.text: The charger in our detached garage needed a trench across the yard. They planned the route around the old maple and the sod went back nicely. It ran a week behind schedule because of rain.
reviews.name: Erica N.

reviews.text: They rewired the upstairs bedrooms while we lived downstairs. Dust stayed in one room each day and they cleaned up before leaving every afternoon.
reviews.name: Hal R.
